summary: D-056 correctly makes no immediate file-08, SATISFIED, implementation, freeze, claim-register, condition-1, or D-070-union change, and its eligibility exclusions prevent the named DR-103/105/114/118 cases from being promoted today. The central rule is nevertheless internally misclassified. It says D-001 and the live acceptance criteria remain unamended while authorizing a later DR-102 SATISFIED re-record that expressly excludes the CC-1..CC-11 execution which D-015 and the authoritative DR-102 cell expressly require before SATISFIED. That is a successor change to the meaning of SATISFIED and to D-015's active disposition, not evaluation of unchanged evidence. Until the authority conflict is explicitly superseded and reflected in the register contract, later MF-6 promotion would have two incompatible governing rules.

objections.claim: D-056 must identify and execute the scoped successor amendment it actually makes to SATISFIED evidence and to D-015, rather than claiming that D-001 and the existing row criteria are unchanged.
evidence: D-056 lines 11-13 and 145-153 say it does not amend D-001, does not rewrite live cells, and leaves today's cells authoritative.

D-056 lines 131-141 nevertheless define architecture SATISFIED for eligible rows as the accepted design contract or prior D-000 decision plus a named C4/DR-G remainder list, and explicitly remove execution of that remainder from the architecture evidence set.

File 08 lines 26-28 defines SATISFIED as exact acceptance evidence linked and independently reviewed. Its authoritative DR-102 row says the acceptance-evidence cell is discharged only when a harness executes CC-1..CC-11 and that the row remains OPEN until that execution.

Adopted D-015 lines 1216-1232 records the same binding result: DR-102 stays OPEN because no harness executes the classes; using SATISFIED was expressly rejected; condition 2 gains zero SATISFIED rows.

D-056 itself acknowledges the conflict at lines 45-55 and rejects keeping D-015's rule at lines 173-176. Calling that rejection an evaluation rule does not supersede the active D-015 and file-08 requirements.
objections.impact: A later cycle could satisfy D-056's five eligibility steps and write DR-102 SATISFIED without execution while D-015 and the authoritative row still say SATISFIED is forbidden until execution. Readers applying file 08, D-015, and D-056 would derive opposite standings from the same facts. The later independent review prevents fiat but cannot choose between contradictory authorities that D-056 leaves simultaneously active. This also turns a substantive definition-of-done change into an unrecorded semantic amendment, defeating D-001's register-content discipline and reversibility chain.
objections.proposedFix: Choose and record one lawful successor path. If the design/qualification split is intended, relabel D-056 as a scoped successor amendment to D-001/file-08 SATISFIED semantics and explicitly supersede D-015's 'OPEN until executed' and rejected-SATISFIED clauses for the eligible class. State the exact acceptance-evidence decomposition, amend or schedule an exact authoritative register note that removes the conflict before any SATISFIED re-record, and extend reversibility to restore D-001/D-015/file-08 semantics as well as dependent row records. Alternatively, retain the existing SATISFIED meaning and use an explicitly reviewed condition-2 deferral or a dedicated design-complete token/checklist amendment. Re-freeze and re-dispatch.
